text: Caroline (Sweden-born) wears a necklace from her grandma symbolizing love, faith, strength. A friend made her a hand-painted bowl for her 18th birthday, ten years ago. Melanie took her family camping in the mountains last week; her 2 younger kids love nature. Caroline is pursuing counseling/mental health careers, aiming to help trans people; attended an LGBTQ+ counseling workshop last Friday.
